# Poly Haven CC0 photo textures and HDRI skies

Downloaded 2026-11-04 from the official API (https://api.polyhaven.com),
into an empty scratch folder, verified against the API's MD5 and size, then copied here unmodified.
License: CC0 (https://polyhaven.com/license) — no attribution required; authors are listed anyway.
Per-file URL, MD5, SHA256, size and authors: `download_manifest.json` (31 files).

Unity Asset Store assets were deliberately NOT used: the Asset Store terms (ToS 3.8(v), EULA 2.2.1.1(g)) restrict ML training / dataset generation without publisher consent.

| asset | authors | used for |
|---|---|---|
| concrete_floor_worn_001 | Dimitrios Savva, Rico Cilliers | quay aprons, roofs |
| concrete_moss | Rob Tuytel | wet quay-wall band |
| concrete_layers_02 | Rob Tuytel | breakwater core and crown wall |
| asphalt_02 | Rob Tuytel | container yard / roads |
| container_side | Dimitrios Savva | containers (greyscale copy tinted per colour + normal map) |
| corrugated_iron_02 | Jenelle van Heerden, Sergej Majboroda | warehouses, crane machinery house |
| metal_plate | Rob Tuytel | painted crane steel, bollards |
| coast_sand_01 | Rob Tuytel | east beach |
| sparse_grass | Amal Kumar | grassland |
| kloofendal_48d_partly_cloudy_puresky (HDRI 4k) | Greg Zaal, Jarod Guest | sky of `day_clear` |
| syferfontein_18d_clear_puresky (HDRI 4k) | Greg Zaal, Jarod Guest | sky of `day_backlit` |
| kloofendal_28d_misty_puresky (HDRI 4k) | Greg Zaal, Jenelle van Heerden | sky of `light_haze` |

## Terrain textures (added 2026-11-04, CC0, `textures/download_manifest_terrain.json`)

| asset | authors | use |
|---|---|---|
| aerial_grass_rock | Rob Tuytel | land plains (grass material) and clearings inside the synthesized canopy |
| aerial_rocks_02 | Rob Tuytel | rock outcrops inside the synthesized canopy |
| forest_leaves_02 | Rob Tuytel | downloaded, not used yet |
| grass_path_2 | Rob Tuytel | downloaded, not used yet |

`Textures/Canopy/T_canopy_{albedo,normal}.png` are generated by `Tools/make_canopy_texture.py` (seed 7): procedural tree crowns with clearings/outcrops blended from the two aerial scans above.
